rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something happens for no apparent reason.

example.jyutping: mou4 dyun1 dyun1 lok6 daai6 jyu5 wo3

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that the reason is unknown to the speaker.

example.english: He inexplicably didn't go to work today.
example.traditional: 唔知點解佢今日冇返工。
example.jyutping: m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1
